meta.parties: Atchy Kannu Et Al. v. Nagamma

rules.statement: The first defendant-respondent has no title to possess any part of the corpus of the property, except by virtue of an alleged informal agreement which she repudiates.
rules.supporting_quote: "If my view of the construction of the joint will is sound, I think that the appellants are entitled to maintain a quia timet action. The remarks of Sir John Phear C.J. in Fernando v. Silva (ubi sup.) cannot surely apply to a case like the present, where the first defendant-respondent has no title to possess any part of the corpus of the property, except by virtue of an alleged informal agreement which she repudiates."
